name: Lucas Silva

resumeText: Lucas Silva is a Senior Platform Engineer at Brookline Media where he builds the internal platform that product teams deploy onto. He maintains golden paths on Kubernetes with ArgoCD and Helm, manages cloud networking through Terraform, and writes Go-based tooling to reduce friction for developers. Earlier at Harborline Analytics he owned CI/CD delivery. He has recent exposure to MLflow while supporting data science teams, and wants to grow platform support for ML workloads.
